definitions.explanation: A general term for musical instruments of Western origin (piano, violin, guitar, etc.), used in contrast to {和楽器|わがっき} (traditional Japanese instruments).

examples.japanese: ピアノは{洋楽器|ようがっき}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: The piano is one of the Western instruments.

examples.japanese: {店|みせ}には{洋楽器|ようがっき}と{和楽器|わがっき}の{両方|りょうほう}が{並|なら}んでいた。
examples.english: Both Western and Japanese instruments were on display in the shop.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{音楽室|おんがくしつ}にはさまざまな{洋楽器|ようがっき}がそろっている。
examples.english: The school's music room is stocked with a variety of Western instruments.

notes:
Compound of {洋|よう} (Western) + {楽器|がっき} (musical instrument). Almost always used as a contrast term with {和楽器|わがっき} (Japanese instruments). The same {洋|よう}〜 / {和|わ}〜 pattern shows up in {洋食|ようしょく}/{和食|わしょく}, {洋室|ようしつ}/{和室|わしつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋楽器|ようがっき}を{演奏|えんそう}する: to play a Western instrument
- {洋楽器|ようがっき}{店|てん}: Western instrument shop
- {洋楽器|ようがっき}の{種類|しゅるい}: types of Western instruments
